title: Singleton-Attainability and Transparent Access in Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.27293v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Matching mechanisms differ in how much of an agent's preference ranking must be determined and reported to obtain a particular object. A mechanism is singleton-attainable (SA) if every object that an agent can obtain through some report can also be obtained by reporting only that object as acceptable. With an SA mechanism, once an attainable object has been identified, the agent need not rank or report any other object. Singleton-attainability identifies a distinct dimension in matching theory and market design: transparent access to attainable outcomes, separate from incentives, stability, welfare or equity.   We establish general conditions for SA and derive its strategic implications. Top-lift invariance and truncation invariance together imply SA, while strategyproofness and stability each imply SA. translated_title: 匹配中的单点可获得性与透明获取
translated_abstract: 匹配机制在参与者为获得某个特定对象所必须确定并报告的偏好排序信息量上各不相同。如果参与者通过某种报告所能获得的每一个对象，都可以通过仅将该对象报告为可接受而获得，那么该机制就是单点可获得的。在单点可获得机制下，一旦确定了某个可获得的对象，参与者就无需再对任何其他对象进行排序或报告。单点可获得性识别了匹配理论与市场设计中的一个独特维度：对可获得结果的透明获取，它独立于激励、稳定性、福利或公平。我们建立了单点可获得性的一般条件，并推导出其策略性含义。顶部提升不变性与截断不变性共同蕴含单点可获得性，而防策略性与稳定性各自都蕴含单点可获得性。相比之下，对一个防策略、个体理性且非浪费的机制所做的任何帕累托改进都不是单点可获得的。特别地，每一个P（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“单点可获得性（SA）”这一新概念，刻画了匹配机制中独立于激励与稳定性的“透明获取”维度，证明防策略性与稳定性均蕴含SA，但对防策略机制的任何帕累托改进都不是SA。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces singleton-attainability (SA), a new dimension of transparent access in matching whereby an agent can secure an object by reporting only it as acceptable, showing that strategyproofness and stability each imply SA, while no Pareto improvement over a strategyproof mechanism can be SA.
